messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — nightly kernel-eval sweep flagged a regression on aarch64 for seq_len=512.
sasha: saw that. perf-ci-bot posted raw numbers in #ci-artifacts. regression looks specific to the matmul kernel variant we auto-picked.
perf-ci-bot: nightly-sweep 2026-03-16 03:00 UTC
- model: llama-13b
- arch: aarch64 (graviton3)
- seq_len: 512
- kernel_candidate: f16_matmul_opt_v3
- ms/token (baseline v2 kernel): 2.1
- ms/token (v3 pick): 3.5
- note: KV-cache throughput unaffected for seq_len<=128
jonathan: interesting — v3 has a large packed-mma path that wins for short sequences but has heavier prefetch on long prefixes. our selector incorrectly prioritized flops peak over prefix latency for seq_len>256.
maria: can you paste the harness command to repro? I want to run locally on my m6g dev box.
alex: repro steps below (copy from ci job):
```
./bin/kernel-bench --model llama-13b --arch aarch64 --kernel f16_matmul_opt_v3 --seq 512 --batch 1 --kv-cache true --iters 200
```
Also try toggling the batching heuristic: `--batching=adaptive_prefix` vs `--batching=latency_first`.
jonathan: likely root cause: our autotuner scoring function uses `expected_throughput * kernel_flops_score` and doesn't discount prefetch cost for long KV chains. I propose adding a penalty term that scales with seq_len_estimate.
elena: agree. can we add a microbenchmark in CI that sweeps seq_len in {32,128,256,512,1024} and asserts no pick has >1.3x regression over the baseline kernel for any seq_len?
sasha: +1. Also add an aarch64-only job — we missed that in the last rollout. current CI only ran x86 nightly for kernel ranking.
perf-ci-bot: queued job: kernel-rank-seq-sweep-aarch64 (priority: high)
link: https://ci.redwood/example/12345
maria: quick question — is KV cache prefetch enabled by default on aarch64? I remember a toggle from last quarter.
alex: default is `kv_prefetch=true` on dedicated nodes, but in hosted we flip per-customer. the kernel v3 does extra prefetch instructions which spike L1 pressure on graviton3.
jonathan: for immediate mitigation we can: 1) pin selector to prefer v2 for seq_len>=256 on aarch64 2) update scoring function 3) add the CI sweep and a short-term canary rollout
maria: I'll open a PR to adjust selector scoring and add the CI config. assigning to myself and @jonathan for review.
elena: nice. add a note to the rollout docs so ops knows to watch the latency SLOs for chat endpoints.
alex: filing incident-ish ticket for tracking: KER-2026-042 — kernel ranking regression on aarch64. I'll attach logs and perf traces.
sasha: thanks. once PR lands let's run the nightly harness again and re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
